name: Wáng Qiūxiá
source: She runs an eel noodle snack shop in Tainan with her husband. With a motherly charm, she takes great care of others and is an elegant and charming mature woman.
translation: She runs an eel noodle snack shop in Tainan with her husband. With a motherly charm, she takes great care of others and is an elegant and charming mature woman.
